title: Screenshot requests
description: projects/<job>/inputs/requests.json — the user's guidance for each uploaded screenshot, written by the panda-video, panda-carousel or panda-image idea director from the brief (and updated on a scene-plan or stills revise). One entry per upload. Scene numbers are 1-based positions in the scene plan and are binding (carousel: slide numbers; panda-image: 1 = the image). No scenes and no moment = not placed (not used).

moment.description: The user's words when they named a moment instead of a scene number.

instruction.description: How to use it, in the user's words.

shows.description: One line: what the screenshot shows.

placement.description: beside = screenshot next to the character with Remotion chrome (default). held = screenshot composited onto a blank phone screen the character holds (frame:held in the layout).
